mapper.select: SELECT * FROM harvest_batch ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM harvest_batch WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM harvest_batch WHERE plot_id = #{plotId} AND batch_date = #{batchDate}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO harvest_batch (plot_id, batch_date, status, estimate_kg, actual_kg, variety, version) VALUES (#{plotId}, #{batchDate}, #{status}, #{estimateKg}, #{actualKg}, #{variety}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE harvest_batch SET plot_id = #{b.plotId}, batch_date = #{b.batchDate}, status = #{b.status}, estimate_kg = #{b.estimateKg}, actual_kg = #{b.actualKg}, variety = #{b.variety}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{b.id} AND version = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT b.* FROM harvest_batch b JOIN batch_tree bt ON bt.batch_id = b.id WHERE bt.tree_id = #{treeId} AND b.status IN ('待采', '采集中') ORDER BY b.id
SELECT tree_id FROM batch_tree WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY tree_id
